rows: SSH Login: the account may not change the appliance's settings (HTTP 403 reading ssh)
sections.text: The appliance's own SSH Login, DCUI, Console CLI and Bash Shell (its VAMI's Access page, port 5480), set through vCenter's API. CHANGED = set by this run, and read back; a refusal (HTTP 403) means the credential's account is not in SystemConfiguration.Administrators.
sections.title: vCenter appliance access
